post_phase_51n_state.phase_51n_source: Phase 51N: Post-M2 route extraction checkpoint, Agent B docs integration, Claude review preparation pack (#408)

rule_reminder: Agent B does not perform the extraction. Agent B does not modify Agent A files. The 5 extractions are Agent A work. Agent B updates this tracker when the Agent A phase lands, as a normal B-track governance refresh.
expected_phase_numbering_note: The expected future Agent A phase numbering (51O/51P/51Q/51R/51S) is a planning convention, not a commitment. Agent A may number the actual phases differently; the B-track updates the tracker when the actual phase lands.

POST_/projects/{code}/save-as.current_inline_status: inline in main_web.py (Agent A owned). The route handles project save-as; it is the inline counterpart to the projects_create_service.py extracted in Phase 51M-2.
POST_/projects/{code}/save-as.governance_impact: B3 matrix AREA-019 update; B8 architecture dimension increment (12 -> 13 service-backed routes, 13 -> 14 service modules); B14 governance refresh tracker addition.
POST_/projects/{code}/save-as.pilot_impact: If save-as is in pilot scope (B7 + B9), the pilot surface area changes after extraction. Pin refresh or forward-compatibility decision is required if save-as is pilot-claim-allowed.
POST_/projects/{code}/save-as.external_review_impact: B10 data room index update; B16 closeout tracker update.
POST_/projects/{code}/save-as.agent_b_refresh_trigger: When the Agent A phase lands, update this tracker, the B3 matrix, the B8 tracker, the B14 refresh tracker, and the B10 data room index.
POST_/projects/{code}/save-as.notes: Save-as is the most natural follow-up to the projects_create_service.py extraction in 51M-2. The Agent A work on this route will follow the same pattern as 51M-1 (characterization) + 51M-2 (extraction).

status_definitions.pending_agent_a: The route is inline. The Agent A characterization and extraction phases are pending. Agent B tracks but does not perform the work.
status_definitions.characterization_complete: The Agent A characterization phase for this route has landed. The route is still inline but is characterized. The B-track updates AREA-019 to reflect the new characterization.
status_definitions.extraction_complete: The Agent A extraction phase for this route has landed. The route is no longer inline. The B-track updates AREA-019, the B8 architecture dimension, the B10 data room index, and the B16 closeout tracker to reflect the extraction.
status_definitions.cancelled_with_rationale: The Agent A work on this route was cancelled (with rationale). The route remains inline indefinitely.

global_notes: This tracker is internal governance. It is not a code change. It does not authorize Agent B to extract or modify any Agent A file.
Agent B does not perform the extractions. Agent B does not modify Agent A files. The 5 extractions are Agent A work.
The expected future Agent A phase numbering (51O/51P/51Q/51R/51S) is a planning convention, not a commitment.
The no-go claim list is unchanged by the 5 hotspot extractions. The extractions are route / service / code changes on the Agent A track, not no-go category changes.

When the Agent A phase lands, the B-track updates this tracker, the B3 matrix, the B8 tracker, the B14 refresh tracker, the B10 data room index, and the B16 closeout tracker. The B-track does not modify any Agent A file.
